intro: Orrin draws on the regal legacy of Dark Emperador marble. Paired with warm mango wood, its rounded form and rich surface create a statement that feels composed, grounded, and quietly opulent.

features.title: Sophisticated dark Emperador marble top
features.text: The Orrin coffee table features a dark Emperador marble top; a stone quarried in Spain for centuries and admired since Roman times. The table’s deep brown surface with intricate veining brings depth, character, and an elevated finish to living spaces.

features.title: Generous rounded tabletop
features.text: This generously sized, softly rounded tabletop offers ample room for daily essentials, books, and decorative accents. Its curved form supports easy movement around the table while adding a sense of visual softness and balance to the design.

features.title: Robust wood-and-stone construction
features.text: The combination of a solid marble top and sturdy mango wood legs of the coffee table creates a stable, well-balanced structure. This table feels reassuringly grounded, offering dependable support suited to everyday use.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
